blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tycoon Manuel V. Pangilinan is buying additional shares in Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) from San Miguel Global Power Holdings Corp. (SMGP) for P2.19 billion. In a disclosure on Wednesday, San Miguel Corp. (SMC) said its power subsidiary had executed a contract with Pangilinan, chair of Meralco, to sell and purchase shares of stock. […]...
